runbooks.title: shard-keeper: rollback procedure (post-Apr-14 hardened path)
runbooks.body: 1. Re-push prior label map. 2. Confirm rollup-service consumer is reading. 3. Pre-coordinate with Nadia on label-name parity. 4. NEVER deploy from laptop, even on staging.
